decisions.reason: As a two-component resin injection unit, it fits closely with the firm's established plural-component, pumping and injection know-how, so management is likely to keep it and learn from early market use.
This product also lies squarely in the firm's existing resin-handling and injection capability base, which makes continued refinement more attractive than withdrawal.
An automatic airless spray gun is directly aligned with the firm's long-standing spray application and gun portfolio, so absorptive capacity for improvement is very strong.
A manual airless spray gun is highly related to the firm's core products, customers and service organization, making it a low-risk product to retain.
An air-assisted airless spray gun extends an existing application-technology line that the firm already understands well, so management would be inclined to keep it on the market.

A data logger for coating equipment is more novel because it adds a digital monitoring element, but it remains closely tied to the installed equipment base and should be retained while the firm builds experience.
